name: YFN Sterling Silver Caduceus Angel Nurse Pendant (18 in)
seoTitle: Sterling Silver Caduceus Angel Nurse Necklace
metaDescription: A sterling silver caduceus angel pendant on an 18 inch necklace from YFN. A simple, meaningful jewelry gift for a nurse, new grad, or nursing student.
summary: A sterling silver caduceus angel pendant that honors a nurse's work in a simple, wearable way. A classic choice for graduation or a heartfelt thank you.
bestFor: Thank you gifts for a nurse
whyItWorks: Angel imagery and nursing have gone together for a long time, partly because patients and families so often describe a good nurse that way. A sterling silver caduceus angel pendant captures that idea without words. It is a quiet way to tell someone their care mattered, whether that someone is your sister finishing her BSN or the night nurse who looked after your dad.

The 18 inch length listed in the title is a common, easy fit that sits near the collarbone and works with most necklines, from a scrub top to a sweater. Since many nurses skip necklaces during patient care for safety reasons, it often becomes the piece she wears to celebrations, on days off, or tucked under a shirt as a private reminder of why she does the job. Give it at a pinning ceremony, a graduation dinner, or Nurses Week. Check the listing for the pendant size and packaging before ordering.
goodToKnow: The title lists an 18 inch chain, which suits most adults.
Check the listing for the pendant dimensions and whether it comes in a gift box.
Unit dress codes vary, so it may be worn more off shift than at the bedside.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a nursing graduate?
faq.a: Yes, the caduceus angel design is a classic graduation and pinning theme. It is a keepsake she can wear for years.

faq.q: Will the 18 inch chain fit most people?
faq.a: For most adults it sits around the collarbone. If she prefers a longer chain, check whether the listing offers other lengths.
